description: NaAlGeO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmc2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.56 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.52 Å. There are two inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent GeO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent GeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-56°. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.00 Å. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent GeO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent GeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-53°. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.03 Å. There are two inequivalent Ge sites. In the first Ge site, Ge is bonded to six O atoms to form GeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent GeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-53°. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-1.97 Å. In the second Ge site, Ge is bonded to six O atoms to form GeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent GeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-56°. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-1.96 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Al, and two equivalent Ge atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₂AlGe₂ square pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Al, and one Ge atom to form distorted ONa₂Al₂Ge square pyramids that share corners with six ONa₂Al₂Ge trigonal bipyramids, edges with four ONa₂AlGe₂ square pyramids, and edges with four ONa₂Al₂Ge trigonal bipyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Al, and two equivalent Ge atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂AlGe₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Al, and one Ge atom to form distorted ONa₂Al₂Ge trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Al₂Ge square pyramids, corners with three ONa₂AlGe₂ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Al₂Ge square pyramid, and edges with six ONa₂AlGe₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Al, and two equivalent Ge atoms to form distorted ONa₂AlGe₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₂AlGe₂ square pyramids, corners with seven ONa₂AlGe₂ trigonal bipyramids, edges with three ONa₂AlGe₂ square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂Al₂Ge trigonal bipyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Al, and one Ge atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂Al₂Ge trigonal bipyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Al, and two equivalent Ge atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Al, and one Ge atom.
